column1: # Columns: canonical <TAB> apt <TAB> apk <TAB> pacman <TAB> dnf <TAB> xbps <TAB> emerge <TAB> tier <TAB> commands
# canonical  stable systui name, also used for PKG_MAP-style lookups
# dnf        Fedora/RHEL/openSUSE package (zypper uses this column)
# tier       core  = required to start and operate the TUI (install failure is fatal)
#            extra = CLI tooling systui menus and features invoke (failure warns)
#            build = compilers/toolchains for build and rootfs features (failure warns)
# commands   comma-separated executables the package is expected to provide
# Placeholder "-" means the package is unavailable on that distribution; it is
# skipped with a warning instead of failing the install.
